# GraphExplorerPage

The graph workspace: what to play next from the track that is on now, with the graph around it and one selected track open beside it.

`SongNodes.GraphExplorerPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.GraphExplorerPage titleLead="…" title="…" mode="play" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.GraphExplorerPage" title-lead="…" title="…" mode="play"></x-import>
```

## Props (GraphExplorerPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `titleLead` * | `string` | Lead of the thin–bold title, normally the module label. |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold half of the title, also shown in AppHeader. |
| `module` | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services"` | Module that owns the page (colour, drawer row, PageHeader band). Omit for Home. |
| `drawerCounts` | `Partial<Record<ModuleKey, [number, string, StatusKey?]>>` | Drawer counts and attention badges: { pipeline: [2, "scrapers paused", "warn"] }. |
| `mode` * | `"play" \| "plan"` | ?mode=play\|plan; Play is the booth view (recommendations first). |
| `nowPlaying` * | `TrackSummary \| null` |  |
| `recommendations` * | `{ track: TrackSummary; reason: string; score: number }[]` | Up next, ranked; each carries the transition from now playing. |
| `nodes` * | `GraphNode[]` |  |
| `edges` * | `GraphEdge[]` |  |
| `selectedTrackId` | `string` | ?track= — opens the SideSheet. |
| `connection` * | `"live" \| "reconnecting" \| "offline" \| "partial"` | Live updates socket state for ConnectionStatus. |
| `activeFilterCount` * | `number` |  |
| `onSetNowPlaying` * | `(trackId: string) => void` |  |

### TrackSummary

One track as pages display it (rows, slots, recommendations).

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | SongNodes ID, e.g. "trk_8f2a". |
| `artist` * | `string` | Artist credit as shown, e.g. "Bicep". |
| `title` * | `string` | Title, e.g. "Glue". |
| `mix` | `string` | Mix name, e.g. "Original mix". |
| `durationSec` | `number` | Length in seconds. |
| `energy` * | `number \| null` | Energy 1–10, null when not set (shown as an en dash). |
| `key` * | `string \| null` | Camelot key, e.g. "8A"; null when unknown. |
| `bpm` * | `number \| null` | Tempo in BPM. |
| `pillar` | `"House" \| "Techno" \| "UK garage"` | House, Techno or UK garage. |
| `rotation` | `"High" \| "Standard" \| "Vault"` | Library rotation. |
| `heardOn` | `string[]` | Sources it was heard on, newest first ("triple j Mix Up", "1001tracklists"). |
| `lastHeard` | `string` | Date last heard, "2026-10-23". |
| `links` | `Record<string, string>` | External links by service name ("TIDAL", "Beatport"). |
| `needsEnergyCheck` | `boolean` | Flagged "Needs an energy check". |
